data.thesis_note_en: From Yuanbao Search to branded short dramas, check citations, product links and whether the next step works.

items.title: Google推出Gemini 4 Hydrogen，免費App按問題自動選用
items.summary: Google公布Gemini 4 Hydrogen開始推出，面向日常代理任務，並提供Gemini API和AI Studio入口。
highlights: Gemini App免費用戶可在適合的問題由系統自動選用模型。
Google Sheets的接入視乎訂閱資格。
items.why: 行銷團隊可用同一批任務比較模型，並按錯誤類型決定哪些輸出需要審閱。
items.next_step: 用相同的素材分類或活動簡報樣本，核對輸出準確性、等待時間及審稿量。
items.detail: Google把Gemini 4 Hydrogen定位為支援日常代理工作的模型，並列出開發者、企業和消費者的不同入口。Gemini免費用戶在適合的問題由系統自動選用，Sheets接入則視乎訂閱。團隊可先用同一批低風險任務比較輸出，記錄錯誤類型及人工修訂時間。
items.title_en: Google introduces Gemini 4 Hydrogen with automatic selection for eligible free-app prompts
items.summary_en: Google announced the rollout of Gemini 4 Hydrogen for everyday agent workflows, including through the Gemini API and AI Studio.
highlights_en: The free Gemini app can select the model automatically when appropriate to the prompt.
Access in Google Sheets depends on subscription eligibility.
items.why_en: Marketing teams can compare models on the same tasks and use error patterns to decide what needs review.
items.next_step_en: Use the same tagging or campaign brief samples to compare accuracy, waiting time and review workload.
items.detail_en: Google positions Gemini 4 Hydrogen for everyday agent workflows and lists separate developer, enterprise and consumer access routes. Free Gemini app users get automatic selection when appropriate, while Sheets access depends on subscription. Start with the same low-risk tasks and record error types and manual editing time.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: 騰訊推出獨立元寶搜尋，涵蓋網頁及微信內容
items.summary: 騰訊公布元寶搜尋上線，搜尋範圍包括公開網頁、微信公眾號、WeChat Channels及學術文獻。
highlights: 可從瀏覽器進入搜尋網站。
最新版QQ瀏覽器可在引擎設定切換至元寶搜尋。
items.why: 中國市場團隊可抽查品牌問題在不同內容平台的答案和引用來源。
items.next_step: 用品牌及品類各五條問題，記錄引用網址和商品資訊，交予資料負責人核對。
items.detail: 騰訊稱，元寶搜尋以元寶模型支援搜尋流程，可在瀏覽器直接使用，亦可設為最新版QQ瀏覽器的搜尋引擎。公告列出的來源包括網頁、微信公眾號、視頻號和學術文獻。品牌可抽查產品與售後問題的來源，按原頁核對價格、規格及服務條款。若原頁資料已更新，可再比較兩次搜尋結果。
items.title_en: Tencent launches standalone Yuanbao Search across the web and WeChat content
items.summary_en: Tencent launched Yuanbao Search, with stated coverage including web pages, WeChat Official Accounts, Channels and academic literature.
highlights_en: The search website is accessible from a browser.
The latest QQ Browser lets users switch to Yuanbao Search in search-engine settings.
items.why_en: China marketing teams can sample brand questions and check answers and citations across content platforms.
items.next_step_en: Use five brand and five category questions, then send the cited URLs and product details to their owners for review.
items.detail_en: Tencent says Yuanbao Search uses its Yuanbao model across the search workflow. It is available from a browser and can be set as the engine in the latest QQ Browser. Listed sources include web pages, WeChat Official Accounts, Channels and academic literature. Check product and service citations for current prices, specifications and terms. If a source page changes, compare results before and after the update.

items.title: 名創優品曼谷新店用角色分區及打卡活動串連購物
items.summary: 名創優品披露曼谷CentralWorld的MINISO LAND開店做法，以角色主題分區，配合地圖打卡及禮品換領。
highlights: 公司稱自家角色CHOUCHOU在店內作東南亞首發。
店內有角色商品、毛絨玩具及一般商品區。
items.why: 旅遊零售品牌可讓同一角色出現在展示、互動和換領，並分開量度每個環節。
items.next_step: 為各主題區設一個可追蹤的互動點，再對照登記、到店及兌換數字。
items.detail: 名創優品在曼谷CentralWorld開設MINISO LAND，披露以大型視覺裝置和情境展示串連三類商品區。公司亦稱CHOUCHOU在當地首次面向東南亞市場亮相，店內設地圖打卡及禮品換領。團隊策劃相似門店活動時，可把各區互動、兌換和購買分開記錄。
items.title_en: MINISO connects character zones and check-ins at its new Bangkok store
items.summary_en: MINISO described themed retail zones, a map-based check-in and gift redemption at MINISO LAND in Bangkok's CentralWorld.
highlights_en: The company says its own CHOUCHOU character made its Southeast Asian debut there.
The store has character merchandise, plush toys and general merchandise zones.
items.why_en: Travel retailers can use one character across displays, activities and redemptions, then measure those steps separately.
items.next_step_en: Set one trackable interaction in each zone and compare registrations, visits and redemptions.
items.detail_en: MINISO opened MINISO LAND in Bangkok's CentralWorld and described large displays and themed settings across three merchandise zones. It says CHOUCHOU debuted in Southeast Asia there, alongside a map-based check-in and gift redemption. Teams planning similar store activations can separate zone interactions, redemptions and purchases in their tracking.

items.title: 中銀香港冠名港珠澳大橋賽事，新設十公里挑戰組
items.summary: 香港電台報道，港珠澳大橋香港段半馬舉行，本屆增設十公里挑戰組。中國銀行（香港）是賽事冠名贊助商。
highlights: 賽事獲世界田徑聯會認可為白金級道路賽。
香港公益金另獲分配慈善名額。
items.why: 體育贊助團隊可為不同跑程及公益參與設獨立報名和成效指標。
items.next_step: 按跑程及慈善名額整理報名來源、到場率與捐款紀錄，分開評估各項安排。
items.detail: 香港電台確認港珠澳大橋香港段半馬已舉行，本屆設半馬及新增十公里挑戰組。中銀香港為賽事冠名贊助商，香港公益金表示獲分配慈善名額。體育贊助團隊可分開檢視不同賽程與公益參與，並以有效報名、實際出席和捐款等指標核對活動設計。不同類別的指標應以相同觀察期比較。
items.title_en: BOCHK title-sponsored bridge race adds a 10km challenge
items.summary_en: RTHK reported that the Hong Kong section bridge half marathon took place with a new 10km Challenge. Bank of China (Hong Kong) is the title sponsor.
highlights_en: World Athletics recognizes the event as a Platinum Label Road Race.
The Community Chest received a separate allocation of charity places.
items.why_en: Sports sponsors can use separate registration and measurement for distances and charity participation.
items.next_step_en: Break out registration sources, attendance and donations by distance or charity entry.
items.detail_en: RTHK confirmed that the bridge half marathon took place with a new 10km Challenge. BOCHK is the title sponsor, and the Community Chest said it received charity places. Sports sponsors can review participation by race category or charity route and measure valid registrations, attendance and donations separately. Use a consistent observation window when comparing categories.

items.title: 淘寶與天貓以AI品牌短劇接商品頁，京東另試短劇入口
items.summary: 藍鯨科技報道，淘寶短劇與天貓於雙11推出一批AI品牌短劇，平台提供商品、測評或直播入口。
highlights: 一部家居品牌短劇把衣櫃寫成推動情節的道具。
京東另測試短劇小程式。記者實測時暫未找到購物跳轉。
items.why: 品牌可分開檢查產品融入劇情的方式，以及觀眾能否在相應集數完成下一步。
items.next_step: 以一集試稿核對品牌露出、商品連結和可量度的到店或下單事件。
items.detail: 藍鯨科技報道，淘寶短劇與天貓在雙11把部分品牌商品寫進劇情。平台可在劇內接商品連結、達人測評或品牌直播間，實際做法因作品而異。報道亦檢查京東的短劇小程式，發現其介紹寫有同款購物，當次實測未找到跳轉入口。有製作方亦向記者表示，其承製的部分作品未加入直接跳轉。
items.title_en: Taobao and Tmall connect AI brand dramas to shopping as JD tests a separate entry point
items.summary_en: Blue Whale Tech reported that Taobao and Tmall released AI brand dramas for Singles' Day, with options to link products, reviews or livestreams.
highlights_en: One home brand used a wardrobe as a plot device.
JD is testing a mini-program for short dramas. The reporter did not find a shopping link in their test.
items.why_en: Brands can check product integration and whether viewers can take the next step in the relevant episode.
items.next_step_en: Use one pilot episode to validate brand placement, product links and measurable store visits or orders.
items.detail_en: Blue Whale Tech reported that Taobao and Tmall wrote selected products into Singles' Day short dramas. The platform can connect episodes to products, creator reviews or brand livestreams, with implementation varying by title. The reporter also checked JD's mini-program. Its description advertised buying featured products, and the reporter did not find the link in that test. One producer also told the reporter its commissioned work did not yet include direct links.

items.title: 更進新聞：Amazon Ads將DVA+擴至六個市場，包括新加坡
items.summary: Amazon Ads公布DVA+新增六個市場，區內新增新加坡。廣告主可經平台購買展示、影片及音訊廣告。
highlights: 新增市場另有比利時、波蘭、愛爾蘭、埃及和南非。
Amazon列出統一報表及Amazon Marketing Cloud接入。
items.why: 亞太代理商可在新加坡按同一活動檢查多種廣告版型及報表口徑。
items.next_step: 先核對帳戶和版位資格，再用同一受眾設定比較各版型的可用庫存及報表。
items.detail: Amazon Ads把DVA+擴至六個市場，包括新加坡。平台可程式化購買展示、影片及音訊廣告，涵蓋Amazon自有版位和開放網路。Amazon亦列出統一報表和Amazon Marketing Cloud接入。團隊可先確認帳戶所在地與可購版位，再比較各渠道的量度條件。
items.title_en: Update: Amazon Ads expands DVA+ to six markets including Singapore
items.summary_en: Amazon Ads added six DVA+ markets, including Singapore. Advertisers can buy display, video and audio through the platform.
highlights_en: Other new markets are Belgium, Poland, Ireland, Egypt and South Africa.
Amazon lists unified reporting and access to Amazon Marketing Cloud.
items.why_en: APAC agencies can assess formats and reporting in a single Singapore campaign.
items.next_step_en: Check account and placement eligibility, then compare inventory and reports for the same audience across formats.
items.detail_en: Amazon Ads expanded DVA+ to six markets including Singapore. It supports programmatic buying across display, video and audio on Amazon properties and the open internet. Amazon also lists unified reporting and Amazon Marketing Cloud access. Confirm account markets and available placements before comparing measurement across channels.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.followup: 11月6日版報道Attain購物受眾接入，今次新增的是DVA+投放市場。
items.followup_en: The November 6 edition covered Attain purchase audiences. This update covers new DVA+ markets.

items.title: SmallRig在深圳把創作者交流延伸至總部藝術裝置
items.summary: SmallRig稱與深圳國際藝術博物館合辦交流，聚焦AI如何用於影像創作，並在總部揭幕聯合創作的裝置。
highlights: 藝術家Zadok Ben-David分享用AI探索裝置的鳥形，再篩選及修訂。
論壇後公開與藝術家Feng Yu共同創作的《Ode to the Orchid》。
items.why: 影像品牌可把創作者分享、實物展示與日後產品回饋設成可延續的合作。
items.next_step: 用一個工作坊或展品收集創作流程問題，再交產品團隊逐項回覆。
items.detail: SmallRig披露深圳交流會邀請美術館、策展人和藝術家談影像創作。藝術家Zadok Ben-David分享如何反覆修訂由AI輔助探索的鳥形，再選用部分結果。論壇後，SmallRig在總部揭幕與Feng Yu共同創作的裝置，把這次創作者合作由討論延伸到實物展示。
items.title_en: SmallRig extends a Shenzhen creator forum with an installation at its headquarters
items.summary_en: SmallRig says it co-hosted a discussion on AI and image-making with the Shenzhen International Art Museum, then unveiled a co-created installation at its headquarters.
highlights_en: Artist Zadok Ben-David shared how he explored bird forms with AI before selecting and refining them.
SmallRig unveiled Ode to the Orchid, co-created with artist Feng Yu, after the forum.
items.why_en: Imaging brands can connect creator talks, physical displays and later product feedback into a sustained partnership.
items.next_step_en: Use one workshop or installation to collect workflow questions, then have the product team respond.
items.detail_en: SmallRig said museum leaders, curators and artists discussed image-making at its Shenzhen event. Zadok Ben-David shared how he iterated on AI-assisted explorations of bird forms and selected some for his work. SmallRig later unveiled its installation with Feng Yu at headquarters, extending the collaboration from discussion to a physical display.

items.title: Cloudinary計劃把商品圖片及影片優化接入CloudFront
items.summary: Cloudinary公布與AWS的整合計劃，目標是從CloudFront控制台啟用圖片及影片優化。
highlights: 公告描述使用Amazon S3存放媒體且已有CloudFront分發的情境。
預計按裝置、瀏覽器及網路等條件調整送出的素材。
items.why: 電商團隊可趁開放前整理常用商品圖片及影片，保留跨裝置比較基準。
items.next_step: 抽選商品頁，先記錄檔案大小、清晰度和載入時間，再問工程團隊可否試用。
items.detail: Cloudinary計劃讓使用Amazon S3存放媒體的團隊，在現有CloudFront分發中啟用其影像優化工具。公司描述會按瀏覽器、網路、裝置及螢幕條件調整圖片和影片。正式開放時間仍待公布。電商團隊可先為素材清晰度及載入速度訂立測試基準。
items.title_en: Cloudinary plans to integrate image and video optimization into CloudFront
items.summary_en: Cloudinary announced a plan with AWS to enable image and video optimization from the CloudFront console.
highlights_en: The announced workflow covers media in Amazon S3 and existing CloudFront distributions.
Delivery is designed to adapt to conditions such as device, browser and network.
items.why_en: Commerce teams can inventory product assets and set a cross-device baseline ahead of availability.
items.next_step_en: Sample product pages, record file size, visual quality and load time, then ask engineering about trial access.
items.detail_en: Cloudinary plans to let teams with media in Amazon S3 turn on its optimization in an existing CloudFront distribution. It describes adapting images and video to browser, network, device and screen conditions. Availability details are pending. Commerce teams can establish baseline tests for visual quality and load times.

items.title: RWS推出Weava，把不同市場讀者的模擬評估加入翻譯流程
items.summary: RWS公布Weava，結合AI翻譯和模擬讀者評估，供企業處理多市場內容。
highlights: Audience Check可按指定讀者特徵指出疑點並提出修改。
團隊可設定品質門檻，需要額外判斷時交由人員處理。
items.why: 跨境品牌可比較譯文和本地審閱結果，保留需要人工決定的語氣與文化用詞。
items.next_step: 用同一段廣告文案比較兩個市場版本，列出語氣、稱謂及條款的審閱責任。
items.detail: RWS表示，Weava先按素材目的、受眾及品牌語氣整理要求，再由Language Weaver Pro翻譯。Audience Check用模擬讀者角色提出疑點和修改建議，平台可按品質門檻觸發修正，亦保留人員判斷。品牌可先用小批文案比較兩地編輯意見，記錄哪些建議可直接採用。
items.title_en: RWS launches Weava with simulated audience review in translation workflows
items.summary_en: RWS announced Weava, combining AI translation and simulated audience review for content across markets.
highlights_en: Audience Check uses defined reader profiles to flag issues and suggest changes.
Teams can configure quality thresholds and involve people where extra judgment is needed.
items.why_en: Cross-border teams can compare translations with local editorial feedback and retain human decisions on voice and culture.
items.next_step_en: Compare versions of the same ad in two markets and name reviewers for tone, forms of address and terms.
items.detail_en: RWS says Weava identifies content purpose, audience and brand voice before translation with Language Weaver Pro. Audience Check uses simulated reader profiles to suggest revisions. Configured thresholds can trigger corrections, with human judgment available. Use a small copy sample to compare feedback in two markets and record which suggestions reviewers accept.

items.title: Later公布Creator Live，邀品牌和創作者討論長期合作
items.summary: Later計劃在紐約舉辦Creator Live，邀創作者、品牌和平台交流聯盟銷售與長期合作。
highlights: 議程列出POPFLEX創辦人Cassey Ho及YouTube、SharkNinja代表。
創作者須申請出席，名額有限。
items.why: 品牌可把與創作者的第一次合作設為有明確續約條件的試點。
items.next_step: 預先訂好素材使用權、佣金口徑和續約指標，向合作創作者交代。
items.detail: Later公布紐約Creator Live議程。Wayfair代表將與創作者討論如何從一次合作走向長期關係，POPFLEX創辦人Cassey Ho則與YouTube和SharkNinja代表談創作者經營。活動須申請出席。團隊可把素材使用權、佣金和續約條件列入初次合作的書面安排。
items.title_en: Later announces Creator Live with sessions on long-term creator partnerships
items.summary_en: Later plans a New York Creator Live event for creators, brands and platforms to discuss affiliate commerce and sustained partnerships.
highlights_en: The line-up includes POPFLEX founder Cassey Ho and speakers from YouTube and SharkNinja.
Creators must apply to attend and space is limited.
items.why_en: Brands can run a first creator collaboration as a pilot with clear renewal criteria.
items.next_step_en: Define usage rights, commission rules and renewal measures in advance and share them with creators.
items.detail_en: Later announced its New York Creator Live agenda. Wayfair and creators will discuss how one-off collaborations can become long-term relationships. POPFLEX founder Cassey Ho joins YouTube and SharkNinja speakers to discuss creator-led businesses. Attendance is by application. Set usage rights, commissions and renewal terms in writing at the outset.
